id: \rSome people climb the tower before challenging Skyla. They think it will help them.
en: \rSome people climb the tower before challenging Skyla. They think it will help them.
it: \rAlcuni salgono sulla torre prima di sfidare Anemone. Pensano che li aiuti.

id: \bI love the taste of defeat. I can learn from it.
en: \bI love the taste of defeat. I can learn from it.
it: \bAdoro il sapore della sconfitta. Posso imparare qualcosa.

id: \rI'm just not feeling it, you know.
en: \rI'm just not feeling it, you know.
it: \rÈ che oggi non mi va proprio, capisci?
